_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'WORK BREAKDOWN STRUCTURE' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.02.06.

f01_WBS_Decomposition_Approach.label: WBS Decomposition Approach
f01_WBS_Decomposition_Approach.guidance: The organizing principle used to decompose scope (e.g., phase-based, deliverable-based, or subsystem-based).

f02_Hierarchy_Levels_and_Coding_Scheme.label: Hierarchy Levels and Coding Scheme
f02_Hierarchy_Levels_and_Coding_Scheme.guidance: Definition of hierarchical levels (Project, Phase/Subsystem, Deliverable, Work Package) and WBS numbering scheme.

f03_100_Percent_Rule_Compliance.label: 100 Percent Rule Compliance
f03_100_Percent_Rule_Compliance.guidance: Confirmation that all parent nodes capture 100 percent of subordinate scope with no external additions.

f04_Level_1_Summary_Elements.label: Level 1 Summary Elements
f04_Level_1_Summary_Elements.guidance: High-level summary nodes representing major phases or principal delivery workstreams.

f05_Level_2_and_3_Intermediate_Deliverab.label: Level 2 and 3 Intermediate Deliverables
f05_Level_2_and_3_Intermediate_Deliverab.guidance: Subordinate deliverables and integrated components decomposing summary elements.

f06_Lowest_Level_Work_Packages_Summary.label: Lowest-Level Work Packages Summary
f06_Lowest_Level_Work_Packages_Summary.guidance: Discrete manageable units of work assigned for cost estimation, scheduling, and control.

f07_Hierarchical_WBS_Outline.label: Hierarchical WBS Outline
f07_Hierarchical_WBS_Outline.guidance: Complete textual outline displaying the hierarchical breakdown of the entire project scope.

f08_Control_Accounts_and_Work_Package_Id.label: Control Accounts and Work Package Identifiers
f08_Control_Accounts_and_Work_Package_Id.guidance: Assigned identifiers mapping control accounts to accounting and management structures.
